services.text: Services Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. It was -5.2 at 31 July 2026, slightly below its five-year norm, improving from -22.6 three months earlier but down from 0.4 a month earlier. ABS mining capex expectations was the largest positive contributor (+10.8), while QLD coal saleable tonnes was the largest negative (-13.3).

products.text: Products Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. The latest reading is +29.4, above its five-year norm; it has eased from +32.0 a month ago but risen from +10.7 three months ago. US new orders for iron and steel mills are the largest positive contributor (+25.0), while inverted AUD/USD is the largest negative (-14.1); AISI capacity utilisation and discontinued CAT sales are excluded.

margin.text: Margin Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At -19.4 on 31 August 2026, it is below its five-year norm; it has weakened from -10.8 a month ago but improved from -23.7 three months ago. AUD/USD is the biggest negative contributor (-33.0), while fitter/welder vacancy tightness is the biggest positive (+13.6); the tungsten policy proxy is excluded pending sufficient history.
